title: KYA ANDHERA HAI PHUPI
body:
Qaid khaane me Sakina ye baya'n karti thi
<<MINI>>
Kya andhera hai Phupi
<<DIVIDER>>
Shama mangwaaiye warna Main nahi'n Jeene ki
<<MINI>>
Kya andhera hai Phupi
<<DIVIDER>>
Apne seene se lagalo Main Tumhare sadqe godh me lelo Mujhe
Dil dhadakta hai Mera khaof se ghabrata hai jee
<<MINI>>
Kya andhera hai Phupi
<<DIVIDER>>
Baba Aajaae'n to tab shimr ko hoga maloom kaon hai Ye Masoom
Kya samajh kar Mujhe yu'n ghurkiya'n deta hai shaqi
<<MINI>>
Kya andhera hai Phupi
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaj ki shab ko bhi Baba kya nahi'n Aaenge Mujhko rulwaaenge
Unke seene pa agar soti to neend aa jaati
<<MINI>>
Kya andhera hai Phupi
<<DIVIDER>>
Baad Mere ya'n agar howe Pidar ka aana Unse ye farmaana
Margayi ghut ke andhere me Tumhari Beti
<<MINI>>
Kya andhera hai Phupi
author: Naheed
